sections.content:
Wait! The black L DID move RIGHT! It went from cols 0-14 back to cols 3-17. So the black L CAN move RIGHT, just not from cols 3-17 earlier. Let me check:
- Before RIGHT: black L at cols 0-14 (boundary [[18, 0], ...])
- After RIGHT: black L at cols 3-17 (boundary [[18, 3], ...])
So the black L moved RIGHT by 3 columns. This means the black L can move both LEFT and RIGHT!
Earlier, when I tried RIGHT from cols 3-17, the black L didn't move. But now, after moving LEFT to cols 0-14 and then RIGHT, it moved back to cols 3-17.
Wait, but earlier I tried RIGHT 5 from cols 3-17 and the black L didn't move. Let me check what happened then...
Actually, looking back at the history:
- After LEFT 4: black L at cols 3-17
- SPACE: no effect
- RIGHT 5: black L still at cols 3-17 (didn't move)
- MOUSE: no effect
- ACTION7: no effect
- LEFT: black L moved to cols 0-14
- RIGHT: black L moved to cols 3-17
So the black L couldn't move RIGHT from cols 3-17 earlier, but could move LEFT. Then after moving LEFT to cols 0-14, it could move RIGHT back to cols 3-17.
This is strange. Maybe the black L has a "momentum" or "direction lock" that only allows it to move in one direction at a time. When I pressed LEFT, it started moving LEFT. When I pressed RIGHT, it couldn't move RIGHT because it was "locked" to LEFT. But after moving LEFT to the edge (cols 0-14), the lock was released and it could move RIGHT.
Or maybe the black L can only move in alternating directions: LEFT, then RIGHT, then LEFT, etc.
Let me test this by pressing LEFT again to see if the black L moves LEFT.
Actually, wait. Let me reconsider. The black L is now at cols 3-17, which matches the yellow L's columns. Maybe this IS the target position, and the level should be complete. But it's not complete yet.
Let me think about what else could be needed. Maybe the goal is to have the black L at cols 3-17 AND the yellow L at some other position. Or maybe the goal is to have the black L and yellow L at the same position (both rows and columns).
But the black L can only move horizontally, not vertically. So it can't reach the yellow L's rows.
Wait, maybe I need to look at this from a different angle. Let me check if there's a pattern in the white dots on the black L. The white dots form the charcoal L's shape. Maybe the goal is to move the black L so that the white dots align with the yellow L's shape.
The yellow L is at rows 42-53, cols 3-17. The black L is at rows 18-29, cols 3-17. They're at the same columns but different rows.
Hmm, let me try pressing DOWN to see if the black L can move vertically now.
